mayura-brass-urli.author: Aparna Sengupta
mayura-brass-urli.title: The heft and engraving are exceptional
mayura-brass-urli.comment: When you pick it up, you instantly feel the sheer weight of genuine bell brass. The floating lotus diyas balance effortlessly without capsizing, and the water stays crystal clear. Arrived impeccably boxed with zero tarnishing.

mayura-brass-urli.author: Vikramaditya K.
mayura-brass-urli.title: The centerpiece of our Diwali celebration
mayura-brass-urli.comment: We paired it with red rose petals and Mogra flowers as guests entered our foyer. The compliment after compliment made this purchase so worth it. The packaging was so exquisite I didn't even have to gift wrap it.

mayura-brass-urli.author: Radhika Sharma
mayura-brass-urli.title: Heirloom quality that will last generations
mayura-brass-urli.comment: I was hesitant about buying brass online, but the artisanal detailing around the peacock plumage is truly hand-chiseled. Solid craftsmanship, authentic bell sound when tapped.

mayura-brass-urli.author: Kunal Singhal
mayura-brass-urli.title: Stunning design, requires seasonal gentle care
mayura-brass-urli.comment: Spectacular piece for festive evenings. A small dab of Pitambari or tamarind paste brings back the warm glow in seconds. Highly recommended.
